never: classify onto a kind the list does not hold
file a copy in a folder instead of against the record
reply with a price, a date or a decision without a release
stays_with_person: deciding a supplier invoice is genuine

provider_block.job: nothing in the inbox is lost, and nothing is answered that a person should answer

with_us.note: No hosted step. The filing write against the record and the release gate are quoted as a scoped build on the mailbox the business already runs.

checks.title: Every message gets exactly one kind from a closed list
A message about a job or a supplier is filed against that record by id
A supplier invoice attachment is filed as evidence with its hash and the message id
Every classified message lands in the queue for its kind, with a named owner and a due date
A complaint is escalated to a named person with the full message, and nothing is sent to the customer
The only automatic outbound is an acknowledgement, and any substantive reply carries a named person's release
Each kind carries a response clock, and an item past its clock escalates to the owner's manager
A follow-up in the same thread updates the existing item
Spam is filed to quarantine with its hash, retrievable, and never deleted by the machine
Message id, kind, record, owner, clock, what was sent and by whom are retrievable by message
